subject: AWS Marketplace product page: VPC & on-prem hero + legal terms
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Draft hero + footnote for VPC / on-prem listing (first pass)

Kimberly / Sergio —

Attaching the first-pass copy for the AWS Marketplace product page focusing on our VPC and on-prem / private deployment story. Key asks:

- Can you confirm legal/marketing have clearance on the footnote about "customer-managed keys & HSM compatibility"? Legal wanted a careful phrase around KMS vs HSM.
- Kim, can you tighten the one-liner to call out Dedicated and Private deployment options separately (we should avoid the phrase "bring your own model" in the hero).
- Sergio, if we add a co-sell badge, what field assets do you need? Do we want to include a trial SKU in the listing?

Attachments: marketplace_asset_list.xlsx, hero_v1.md (copy block)

High-level hero draft (hero_v1.md):
- Headline: "Run Redwood Inference where your data stays: hosted, VPC, or on‑premises"
- Subheadline: "SLA-backed Dedicated capacity and private deployments for regulated workloads — bring predictable latency and cost to production inference."
- Footnote: "Private deployments support customer-controlled KMS; HSM integrations available via partner adapters — contact Sales for certification."

This is intentionally conservative — want to avoid implying certified HSM plugins until we have the partner integration tested. Putting the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/redwood/aws-listing-vpc-hero-draft

Would like edits by end of day tomorrow so we can show EdgeCloud a clean draft in our co-sell packet.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 13:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Draft hero + footnote for VPC / on-prem listing (first pass)

On Tue, May 21, 2028 at 9:12 AM Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kimberly / Sergio —
> 
> Attaching the first-pass copy for the AWS Marketplace product page focusing on our VPC and on-prem / private deployment story. Key asks:
> 
> - Can you confirm legal/marketing have clearance on the footnote about "customer-managed keys & HSM compatibility"? Legal wanted a careful phrase around KMS vs HSM.

Thanks Alex — quick notes inline and a tightened hero (attached hero_v2.md).

Edits / recommendations (high level):
1) Headline: shorten to "Inference inside your cloud or data center" — punchier for marketplace tiles.
2) Subheadline: reorder to emphasize SLA + isolation: "SLA-backed Dedicated capacity and private deployment options with customer-managed keys."
3) Footnote: legal suggests: "Customer-managed encryption keys supported via AWS KMS. HSM integrations are available through validated partner solutions; contact Sales for details." That removes any claim of native HSM certification.
4) Trial SKU: recommend a 14-day trial PrivateOffer with a capped token allowance for the Dedicated SKU — reduces procurement friction.

I've attached asset_checklist_v2.xlsx with required images (hero 1200x675), AMI/VM packaging notes, and a placeholder for the SOC 2 evidence link.

I'll run the final copy by legal after we lock the AMI/packaging statement.

Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace & GTM Ops
kimberly@redwood.com

Attachments: hero_v2.md, asset_checklist_v2.xlsx

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: EdgeCloud Solutions <procurement@edgecloud.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 08:20:00 -0000
Subject: Redwood AWS listing draft + co-sell offer (for review)

Rachel / EdgeCloud team —

Thanks again for the co-sell sync last week. Attaching a draft of the AWS Marketplace product page copy we plan to publish — this focuses on private deployment and Dedicated capacity. Highlights:

- Short hero that calls out "inference inside your cloud or data center"
- Subhead that mentions SLA-backed Dedicated capacity and customer-managed keys
- Footnote describing KMS support and partner-led HSM integrations

Attachments: hero_v2.md, marketplace_asset_list.xlsx (updated)

Two asks from your side so we can finalize:
1) Confirm whether you want the co-sell badge to reference "EdgeCloud validated" (we can use that language if you confirm.)
2) Can you confirm procurement preference for a 14-day trial PrivateOffer SKU (we will include a capped token allowance) or prefer a 30-day trial?

If this looks good we will: (a) publish the listing copy to AWS once legal signs off; (b) create the PrivateOffer in DocuSign for signature (link below); (c) add the trial SKU and co-sell badge.

DocuSign (PrivateOffer preview): https://www.docusign.com/PRIVATEOFFER/EDGE-2028-003
Drive (draft assets): https://drive.google.com/redwood/aws-listing-vpc-hero-draft

Looking forward — tagging Sergio for any packaging/AMI notes.

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Torres <rachel@edgecloud.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgecloud.com
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 16:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Redwood AWS listing draft + co-sell offer (for review)

Alex —

Thanks — the copy reads well. A few items from our security and procurement teams:

- Trial length: procurement prefers a 30-day trial for evaluation. Can you confirm token caps and overage terms?
- Compliance: we need a SOC 2 Type II attestation copy linked from the marketplace listing (or a clear path to request it).
- AMI / deployment artifacts: we usually require an AMI and a container image with a small integration test for verification. Is that available for the private deployment path?
- KMS/HSM: we are happy with the proposed footnote; we will market the offering as "EdgeCloud-validated instance with customer-managed keys" — confirm that is okay.

Attached is our SOW template (EdgeCloud_SOW.pdf) with the procurement team’s standard terms. We can redline once the PrivateOffer is created.

If you can confirm the AMI availability and the SOC 2 link, we can sign the PrivateOffer and proceed with the co-sell badge usage.

Thanks,
Rachel Torres
Head of Strategic Partners, EdgeCloud Solutions
procurement@edgecloud.com

Attachments: EdgeCloud_SOW.pdf
